title: Ease is not after hardship. It is inside it.
subtitle: Where relief actually lives

picture.src: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 190" role="img" aria-label="One hardship box containing two ease boxes"> <rect x="20" y="30" width="280" height="130" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="{{trap}}" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/> <text x="36" y="22" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="{{trap}}" letter-spacing="1.5">THE HARDSHIP</text> <rect x="48" y="70" width="100" height="56" rx="9" fill="{{good}}"/> <text x="98" y="104" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">ease</text> <rect x="172" y="70" width="100" height="56" rx="9" fill="{{good}}"/> <text x="222" y="104" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">ease</text> <text x="160" y="150" font-size="12" fill="{{muted}}" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic">"with", not "after"</text> <text x="160" y="182" font-size="12" fill="{{idea}}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">one hardship, two eases</text> </svg>

key.label: The one word that changes it

row.title: with
sub: ma'a: one hardship, two eases, same season

then: Makkah. Rejection, mockery, few followers. Allah did not say "it will end." He said: {idea}look inside it, ease is already there, and it is there twice.{/idea}
now: Months of job hunting. A sick parent. You keep saying {trap}"when this is over."{/trap} The verse says: do not wait for over. {idea}Find the ease that is here already.{/idea}
new: One season, both at once. Find the second one.
try: Name one ease you have right now, inside your current difficulty. Write it down.

title: He ran. She grabbed. She spoke first.
subtitle: Doing right leaves evidence, even while the lie is being told

picture.src: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 190" role="img" aria-label="Path from the room to the door, shirt torn from behind, husband waiting"> <defs><marker id="a" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="{{idea}}"/></marker> <marker id="w" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="{{trap}}"/></marker></defs> <rect x="14" y="56" width="76" height="40" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="{{line}}" stroke-width="1.5"/> <text x="52" y="80" font-size="12" fill="{{muted}}" text-anchor="middle">locked room</text> <line x1="94" y1="76" x2="196" y2="76" stroke="{{idea}}" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#a)"/> <text x="145" y="66" font-size="12" fill="{{idea}}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">Yusuf runs</text> <path d="M100 100 C130 118, 160 118, 190 100" fill="none" stroke="{{trap}}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#w)"/> <text x="145" y="128" font-size="12" fill="{{trap}}" text-anchor="middle">she chases, shirt torn from the back</text> <rect x="204" y="44" width="56" height="64" rx="6" fill="{{idea}}"/> <text x="232" y="81" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">DOOR</text> <circle cx="292" cy="62" r="11" fill="{{people}}"/> <rect x="282" y="76" width="20" height="26" rx="5" fill="{{people}}"/> <text x="292" y="118" font-size="11" fill="{{muted}}" text-anchor="middle">husband</text> <rect x="20" y="146" width="280" height="34" rx="8" fill="{{rewardSoft}}" stroke="{{reward}}" stroke-width="1.5"/> <text x="160" y="167" font-size="12" fill="{{fg}}" text-anchor="middle">torn from the back = he was leaving, not coming</text> </svg>

then: A slave in a minister's house in Egypt. Doors locked, the wife pressing him. He chose the door and got caught at it anyway. {trap}She spoke first, as the victim.{/trap}
now: You did the right thing and it still blew up. The person who pushed you now tells the manager, the family, the group chat, that {trap}you were the problem.{/trap} {idea}Truth was on him while the lie was being told.{/idea}
old: Doing right protects me from being accused.
new: Doing right leaves evidence. The shirt was torn from the back.
try: Caught in a false version of events? State what happened once, plainly. Then let the torn shirt speak.

title: You give one. Allah grows it to seven hundred.
subtitle: How spending for Allah is counted

picture.src: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 190" role="img" aria-label="One seed growing into seven ears of a hundred grains each"> <circle cx="160" cy="170" r="7" fill="{{idea}}"/> <text x="160" y="186" font-size="11" fill="{{idea}}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="600">1 seed</text> <g stroke="{{good}}" stroke-width="2" fill="none"> <path d="M160 163 C160 120, 40 120, 40 70"/><path d="M160 163 C160 120, 80 120, 80 60"/><path d="M160 163 C160 120, 120 115, 120 52"/> <path d="M160 163 L160 48"/> <path d="M160 163 C160 120, 200 115, 200 52"/><path d="M160 163 C160 120, 240 120, 240 60"/><path d="M160 163 C160 120, 280 120, 280 70"/> </g> <g fill="{{reward}}"> <ellipse cx="40" cy="58" rx="12" ry="18"/><ellipse cx="80" cy="48" rx="12" ry="18"/><ellipse cx="120" cy="40" rx="12" ry="18"/><ellipse cx="160" cy="36" rx="12" ry="18"/> <ellipse cx="200" cy="40" rx="12" ry="18"/><ellipse cx="240" cy="48" rx="12" ry="18"/><ellipse cx="280" cy="58" rx="12" ry="18"/> </g> <g font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#2a1f05" text-anchor="middle"> <text x="40" y="62">100</text><text x="80" y="52">100</text><text x="120" y="44">100</text><text x="160" y="40">100</text><text x="200" y="44">100</text><text x="240" y="52">100</text><text x="280" y="62">100</text> </g> <text x="160" y="14" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="{{reward}}" text-anchor="middle">7 × 100 = 700, "and more for whom He wills"</text> <text x="302" y="118" font-size="11" fill="{{muted}}" font-style="italic" text-anchor="end">planted, not spent</text> </svg>

row.title: times 700
sub: planted, not spent, and more for whom He wills

then: New community in Madinah, poor, building a mosque, feeding migrants. Giving felt like losing. {idea}Allah showed them farming instead of subtracting.{/idea}
now: Salary just hit. Rent, bills, a bit left. The donation link is open. Your brain says {trap}"minus 50."{/trap} The verse says {reward}"times 700."{/reward}
old: Giving is subtraction from my account.
new: Giving is planting. The seed leaves my hand so it can grow.
try: Give one small amount today. Picture seven ears.

title: His uncle cursed him. Allah returned the curse, forever.
subtitle: The only enemy named in the Quran, and what he said

picture.label: What he said, on the hill

then: The Prophet ﷺ climbed a hill, called all of Makkah, and warned them. His own uncle stood up, dusted off his hands: {trap}"Is this why you gathered us? May you perish."{/trap} The one man whose job was to protect him.
now: The relative who mocks your choices at every gathering. The one who should have your back and {trap}laughs the loudest instead.{/trap} You keep hoping blood will fix it. {idea}Allah defended His Prophet when his uncle would not.{/idea}
old: Family will come around if I keep proving myself.
new: Some will not. Your worth does not wait on their approval.
try: Stop rehearsing the argument with that relative. Do your work. Let the record be written elsewhere.

title: Money and sons bought him nothing.
subtitle: What he planned to pay with on the Day
then: Abu Lahab was rich, connected, with grown sons. Warned about the Day, he said: {trap}if it is true, I will ransom myself with my wealth and my children.{/trap} This verse is the reply.
now: The savings account. The pension. The kids who will "take care of me." The network. Everything you quietly count on when the thought of death passes through. {idea}Blessings for here, not currency for there.{/idea}
old: What I own and who I raised are my safety net.
new: Nothing I own crosses with me except what I did with it.
try: Name one thing you are secretly relying on instead of Allah. Say it out loud.

title: Father of Flame. Allah told him where the flame ends.
subtitle: A proud nickname, turned over

row.title: Abu Lahab
sub: a glowing face, a proud name

key.label: What a name is made of

then: His real name was Abdul-Uzza. People called him Abu Lahab because his face shone, and {reward}he loved the name.{/reward} The verse turns it over: {trap}the flame will not be on his face. He will be inside it.{/trap}
now: The reputation you polish. The title, the nickname, the way people describe you at parties. Built on what? {trap}If it is built on someone else's back, it has an ending.{/trap}
old: A good name is what people call me.
new: A good name is what my deeds will be called on that Day. The rest is lighting.
try: Ask what one person you have wronged would call you. Fix that before polishing anything else.

title: She carried the wood that fed his fire.
subtitle: Feeding a fire is its own deed

row.title: the wood
sub: thorns on his path, stories, fuel

row.title: carrying the wood
sub: counts the same as lighting it

then: Umm Jamil, sister of Abu Sufyan, one of the leading women of Quraysh. She scattered thorns on the path the Prophet ﷺ walked at night. {trap}She was not dragged into her husband's hatred. She fed it.{/trap}
now: The friend who, every time you are angry, adds a story. The spouse who never says "let it go." The group chat that keeps a grudge alive for years. {idea}Wood carriers.{/idea}
old: I am only reacting to what others started.
new: Feeding a fire is its own deed. Carrying the wood counts the same as lighting it.
try: Think of one grudge you keep warm for someone else. Put the wood down.

title: The rope she carried harm with, now on her neck.
subtitle: What you carry for others, you wear

row.title: my weapons are separate from me
what I carry for others, I wear

then: A rope of palm fiber was a worker's tool: bind the bundle, carry it on your back. She used hers to carry harm. The surah ends with {trap}the same rope, twisted, on her neck.{/trap} The tool became the sentence.
now: The sharp tongue that wins every argument. The talent for finding people's weak spots. The screenshot folder. {idea}Whatever you use to hurt, you are also tying to yourself.{/idea}
old: My weapons are separate from me. I pick them up, I put them down.
new: What I carry for others, I wear.
try: Delete one thing you kept as a weapon.
